name: dsh-cli
notes: Expectations were captured from real runs of dsh 0.1.2-rc.1 on macOS arm64 / Node v22.23.0, not read off documentation. Cases that touch profile state run with an isolated DSH_HOME={tmp}/home so they never modify the operator's real ~/.dsh. Cases marked xfail assert the behaviour a launcher should have; they fail today and name the defect. Fix the defect, then drop the xfail flag instead of deleting the case. DSH-PLG-004/005 need network access to the npm registry (they assert a 404 passthrough).

cases.title: 查看启动器帮助
查看版本号
web 别名与 --profile web 等价
cases.notes: `dsh web --help` must print the same usage line as `dsh --profile web --help` (DSH-CLI-006), proving the alias boots the same profile.

cases.title: 首个未识别 token 后参数归 app
cases.notes: --profile web --help must print the web app's own help, not the launcher help.

cases.title: 缺少 --profile 值
未知 flag 报错应指出该 flag
cases.notes: Actual stderr is "error: --profile <name> is required": the unknown option is never named, so the operator cannot tell which token was rejected.
cases.defect: DSH-BUG-002 启动器对未知 flag 报出与被拒参数无关的 --profile 必填错误，未指出真正的问题参数

cases.title: 非法 profile 应干净报错而非抛异常
cases.notes: Actual stderr is a 1 kB uncaught-exception dump: the source line, a caret marker, "Error: dsh: profile ... does not exist", five stack frames and the Node.js version footer.
cases.defect: DSH-BUG-001 启动器配置/参数错误抛出未捕获异常，Node 堆栈与源码行泄漏到 stderr，无用户友好错误信息

cases.title: plugin 模式应拒绝 app 专属选项
cases.notes: Actual: the launcher forwards --port to pnpm, which fails with "[ERROR] Unknown option: 'port' / Did you mean 'sort'?" — a misleading message that never says the option does not belong to plugin mode. Exit code is non-zero as required; only the message is wrong.
cases.defect: DSH-BUG-003 plugin 模式未拦截 web app 专属选项，--port 被透传给 pnpm，报出 "Did you mean 'sort'?" 等与插件模式无关的误导性错误

cases.title: web profile 首次自动初始化
cases.notes: With a fresh DSH_HOME the launcher must silently create the profile from its template before composing; the created profile directory is the observable signal (auto-init prints nothing, verified against the real binary).

cases.title: 非内置 profile 不自动初始化
cases.notes: Fails with exit 1 and names the missing profile, but the error is raised as an uncaught exception with five stack frames and the Node.js footer.
cases.defect: DSH-BUG-001 同 DSH-CLI-004：不存在的 profile 抛未捕获异常，Node 堆栈与源码行泄漏到 stderr

cases.title: dump 默认配置不含用户层与 patch 层
cases.notes: Hermetic contrast with DSH-BOOT-005: the fixture installs a home-layer patch that inserts probe-home-layer; the default dump must exclude it (and the agentloop-probe overlay used in DSH-BOOT-007).

cases.title: dump 完整配置包含用户层
cases.notes: The full dump must compose the home-layer patch from the fixture DSH_HOME.

cases.title: 补丁层组合顺序 bundle → home → --patch
cases.notes: The dump must contain all three layers, and the home-layer entry must appear before the --patch entry (later layers append after earlier ones).

cases.title: --patch 覆盖层生效
--patch 可重复且按传入顺序应用
--patch 指向不存在文件应干净报错
cases.defect: DSH-BUG-001 同 DSH-CLI-004：overlay 读取失败同样抛未捕获异常并泄漏堆栈

cases.title: --patch 非法 YAML 应干净报错
cases.defect: DSH-BUG-001 同 DSH-CLI-004：YAML 解析失败抛未捕获异常，错误位置信息被堆栈淹没

cases.title: 安装本地插件包到 profile
cases.notes: Adds a file-fixture package by path so the case runs offline; pnpm links it and dsh warns that the package declares no dsh.bundle. A positive remove was verified manually (see the test report): it cannot be chained into a single argv.

cases.title: 移除未安装的包报错透传
cases.notes: pnpm must fail and its error must reach the operator; the non-zero exit code propagates through dsh.

cases.title: plugin 缺少 --profile 报错
目标 profile 不存在时按设计初始化再失败
cases.notes: Requires network (npm registry 404). Corrects the manual test doc: BOOT-003's own error message tells operators to create profiles via `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <package>`, so initializing the missing profile first is by design. Observed: exit 1, and the ghost profile directory is left behind initialized with empty dependencies (asserted via file_exists).

cases.title: 安装不存在的包时 pnpm 错误详情透传
cases.notes: Requires network (npm registry 404). The pnpm 404 detail must appear on stdout so the operator can tell a missing package from a broken registry; dsh must not swallow it.

cases.title: 非数字端口应干净报错
cases.notes: Boundary value for the web app's --port option; the app validates before binding, so the case exits fast.

cases.title: 端口越界应干净报错
cases.notes: Boundary value 70000 > 65535. The validation reason is present in the message, but it is raised as an uncaught exception with the source line and a ValidationError stack.
cases.defect: DSH-BUG-001 同 DSH-CLI-004：配置校验失败抛未捕获异常，ValidationError 堆栈泄漏到 stderr
